title: Tiny, cute windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground / hill -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='40' ry='12' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='36' ry='9' fill='#66BB6A'/>

  <!-- windmill body (tower) -->
  <polygon points='50,30 62,82 38,82' fill='#E8D5A3'/>
  <polygon points='50,30 62,82 50,82' fill='#D4B97A'/>

  <!-- tower cap / roof -->
  <polygon points='50,22 60,34 40,34' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <polygon points='50,22 60,34 50,34' fill='#A93226'/>

  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='46' y='68' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <rect x='46' y='68' width='4' height='14' rx='4' fill='#A0522D'/>

  <!-- window -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#87CEEB'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#D4B97A' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- windmill blades -->
  <g transform='translate(50,30)'>
    <!-- blade 1 (up) -->
    <rect x='-2.5' y='-24' width='5' height='22' rx='1.5' fill='#F5F5DC'/>
    <rect x='-1' y='-24' width='2' height='22' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <!-- blade 2 (right) -->
    <rect x='2' y='-2.5' width='22' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#F5F5DC'/>
    <rect x='2' y='-1' width='22' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <!-- blade 3 (down) -->
    <rect x='-2.5' y='2' width='5' height='22' rx='1.5' fill='#F5F5DC'/>
    <rect x='-1' y='2' width='2' height='22' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
    <!-- blade 4 (left) -->
    <rect x='-24' y='-2.5' width='22' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#F5F5DC'/>
    <rect x='-24' y='-1' width='22' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>

    <!-- hub -->
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='4' fill='#8B4513'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#A0522D'/>
  </g>

  <!-- little clouds beside it -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='25' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='23' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='40' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='38' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
</svg>
